Ground Ops

Chariot porte-fret

A small wheeled platform or trailer used on the ramp to transport ULDs, baggage containers, or cargo pallets between aircraft and terminals.

Questions and answers

What is Chariot porte-fret?

In this glossary, Chariot porte-fret refers to: A small wheeled platform or trailer used on the ramp to transport ULDs, baggage containers, or cargo pallets between aircraft and terminals.

How is Chariot porte-fret used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Sol, Turkish 134, le chariot à bagages n’a pas encore quitté la position, repoussage non autorisé."
